items.t: Signed a certification that Roe v. Wade had been overturned, which allowed Arkansas's trigger ban on abortion to take effect immediately after the Supreme Court ruling (2022).

items.t: Said Walgreens failed to report suspicious prescription orders at its Arkansas locations, which she said worsened the oversupply of opioids and fueled an illegal secondary market.
items.q: The pharmacy chain, according to Rutledge, failed to report any suspicious prescription orders at its Arkansas locations and therefore exacerbated "the oversupply of such drugs and fueling an illegal secondary market.”
